source_name: ČNB – Archiv Komise pro cenné papíry (predecessor regulator archive)
why_relevant: Pre-2006 material from the Securities Commission, absorbed into ČNB on unification of supervision. Matters for long-horizon institutional memory and for tracing the provenance of methodologies still cited today; also flags that ČNB does preserve predecessor-body corpora rather than deleting them.

source_name: Kurzy.cz — mirrored MF/agency legislative press notices
why_relevant: Aggregator that republishes MF comment-procedure notices verbatim; useful as a redundancy channel and as an RSS-friendly proxy if mf.gov.cz crawling becomes unreliable.

source_name: Kurzy.cz — CCyB rate time series page
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator presenting the countercyclical buffer rate history in one table — convenient for quick historical cross-checking of rate/effective-date pairs, but must be validated against the ČNB opatření obecné povahy, never treated as authoritative.

Small-practice cs explainer; low authority individually but useful as a breadth indicator of how widely DORA obligations have diffused into the Czech adviser market, and occasionally restates dates clearly.

source_name: DUBA LEGAL — Pojišťovací a bankovní právo
why_relevant: Czech boutique covering banking/insurance and payment-transaction law; minor actor, listed for actor-map completeness and occasional payment-services commentary.

source_name: JenPráce.cz / Práce za rohem – secondary CZ job boards (AML & compliance roles)
why_relevant: Secondary boards republish bank/PSP compliance ads with full Czech-language duty descriptions (AML/CFT, GDPR, insurance & pension distribution regulation), often more scrapable than jobs.cz and useful as a redundancy channel.

source_name: ochranaudaju.cz – Czech data-protection professional news aggregator
why_relevant: Specialist secondary outlet republishing and interpreting ÚOOÚ outputs; useful as a change-detection tripwire and for context, not as a primary record.

Finance/economics outlet tied to the Roklen group; publishes practitioner interviews on why fintechs collide with Czech and EU regulation and on EU market integration — a source of critique-of-regulation framing.

source_name: SCHEJBAL & PARTNERS — DORA impact analysis / documentation service pages
why_relevant: Service-offer pages rather than alerts, but they reveal in Czech which DORA obligations Czech firms are actually buying help with (documentation sets, impact analysis) — an indirect demand signal for compliance-driven spend.

source_name: Visa Czech Republic – Pravidla a předpisy platné pro karty Visa
why_relevant: Czech-language landing page pointing to the applicable Visa rules; confirms the local-language framing and gives the CZ entry point for scheme-rule references used by Czech merchants/acquirers.
